howToUse: Copy this file, replace every REPLACE value and fill `observations`. Schema and rules: docs/quality-gates.md, "Evidence file schema v2".
Freeze the candidate first: node tools/jef-candidate-manifest.mjs --id <id> --out <dir>/candidate-manifest.json
Never add a coverage field: coverage is computed by tools/lib/evidence-lint.mjs from requiredScenarios.
Check without any API call: npm run jef:lint -- --evidence <file> --out <dir>

automatedObservation.method: Ten minute natural run with real keyboard and mouse input, frame times sampled every frame.
automatedObservation.result: Frame time p95 stayed under the desktop bound for the whole run. Two frames were longer than fifty milliseconds.
automatedObservation.limits: One machine. No dense stress in this run.

agentObservedObservation.inspector: vision-agent: <name of the reviewing agent, not the implementer>
agentObservedObservation.method: Inspected twenty four native captures: desktop high and mobile low, quiet and dense combat, six locations.
agentObservedObservation.result: No mesh passes through another in twenty three captures. In one capture the sword tip enters the shield during the charge.
agentObservedObservation.limits: Stills only; motion was not inspected here.

ownerObservation.method: Ten minute scripted session from owner-session-form.md, portrait then landscape, both classes.
ownerObservation.result: The owner moved and attacked with two thumbs at once, used the three skills and picked one card by touch. Sound started on the first touch.
ownerObservation.verbatim: Movi e ataquei ao mesmo tempo sem falha. O som tocou no primeiro toque.
